about: Where to listen to games. Read by radio_links.py on Windows and RadioLinks.swift on the iPhone, which keeps a byte-equal copy at iOS/SportsScoresApp/SportsScores/radio_links.json. Teams are keyed by ESPN team id. Every link opens a web page; none is a stream. tools/validate_espn.py opens them nightly.
